name: GearGal Equipment Shop
teaser: Armor, Rigs, and Backpacks that you actually want to use. A simple trader that will supply what you need to ignore Ragman forever.
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
I hate barter trades. I hate leveling up to 30+ just to get armor I like. So I made this trader in a fit of rage. She sells all the best armors, backpacks, rigs, as well as some other wearable equipment. I’ll be updating her as seems appropriate.

Think AKGUY or AR Shoppe but for gear. Skip ragman, he’s a nerd, go buy from the Gear Gal.
